title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Universe Is Wrapping Things Up
description: Rhonda reads the stars. Every sign's doom has quietly already started. Ronnie wants one good sign. His ended last Tuesday.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars. <p:0.3> With Rhonda.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Good evening. The universe is wrapping things up. Quietly. <p:0.3> It has already begun.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Begun. Okay. What has begun, exactly?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. A small change becomes a large one. Your favorite mug will be donated by someone who loves you. <p:0.3> They have already begun.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Donated my mug? Out of LOVE? That's somehow worse.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Cancer. The houseplant you forgot is no longer a plant. Do not ask what it is now. <p:0.3> It has already begun.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I... I have a forgotten houseplant. I'm not asking. Moving on.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Libra. Your group chat will end this week. Not the conversation. The friendship. <p:0.3> The transformation is complete by Thursday.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Thursday's pretty specific for a cosmic event, Rhonda.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Capricorn. A familiar door will lock behind you forever, and the click will be gentle, <p:0.3> and you will call it growth.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, that's four doomed signs in a row. Please. Just give me ONE good sign. One.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: I would, Ronnie. <p:0.3> But your sign already ended. Last Tuesday.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [surprise-ah] It WHAT? Last Tuesday? Why did nobody tell me?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Nobody wanted to. <p:0.3> It had already begun.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We'll be right back. <p:0.3> Apparently. We'll see.
